title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death
description: Meg Raspberry is just an apprentice witch celebrating her 17th birthday. That is, until Faust, her magic teacher and Perennial Witch of the Seven Sages, suddenly reveals she is going to die. To stop the Death Sentence curse, Meg must create the Seed of Life using tears of joy from 1,000 people. Join Meg on her travels as she collects the happy tears from everyone she meets to gain eternal life!

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Meg's friend Fine requests her help with fixing a watch.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Meg is visited by Inori, the Witch of Wisdom, while Faust is away on business.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Meg helps Sophie, the Witch of Blessings and one of the Seven Sages, open the gate at the Otherworld Festival.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: While preparing for the parade, Meg and Sophie meet Marie, a woman looking for the man she met a year ago.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Meg brags to Faust about how easy it has become to collect tears and is forbidden from using magic.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Meg attends a special magic ceremony held once every 20 years.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Meg sees a burn-like scar on a girl's neck that is only visible to her.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The sacred tree of Lapis has become polluted by magic and must be removed to prevent further damage.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Meg and Inori visit Aquamarine, a resort destination with a cutting-edge medical facility.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Meg and Jack experience a breakthrough in their research, and a massive disaster threatens the entire island.

episodes_data.title: Once Upon a Witch’s Death Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Meg has mysterious nightmares about a lone witch floating above a destroyed city.
